in_sanskrit.name: Hiya
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Sun's rays
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Hiya एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Hiya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'hīyā' which means 'sun's rays'. In Hindu mythology, the sun is considered a powerful symbol of life, energy, and vitality. The name Hiya is believed to bestow upon the child the strength, courage, and wisdom of the sun.
